Sanskrit-first: bīja-vowels held letter-exact (a i u / ā ī ū / e oṃ / ai au / e ai o au / am / aḥ); ra/la, varga-names (ka ca ṭa ta pa), and Śrīkālikā kept as terms. Read aloud: cadence-checked — each seed and count lands on stress. Inertness-escape: 'so much does he contemplate' — measure parallel kept.

lines: For self-nature's contemplation would in truth
be mere inertness. This one does not lean on another —
the womb of supreme sound, so called: as much as he is
the Lord's world-establishing power-group, so much
l4.sanskrit_cite: svarūpānāmarśane hi vastuto jaḍataiva syāt āmarśaś ca ayaṃ na sāketikaḥ api tu citsvabhāvatāmātranāntarīyakaḥ paranādagarbha uktaḥ sa ca yāvān viśvavyavasthāpakaḥ parameśvarasya śaktikalāpaḥ tāvantam āmṛśati

reads_against.argmap: Does svarūpa-āmarśa reduce to jaḍatā — and what saves it? → Āmarśa escapes jaḍatā by being citsvabhāva-identical: the contemplating measure equals the world-establishing śakti-measure.
c1_essence: Self-nature contemplation would be inertness — saved from that only by being inseparable from consciousness-nature, the womb of supreme sound.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vimarśa weight (rest carrying the letter-scheme)
